basic_profile.name: Jayanta Banerjee
basic_profile.headline: Group CIO Tata Steel Ltd | On Boards of mjunction & TSGCCL
basic_profile.summary: Jayanta Banerjee is a member of the senior management team, an IT industry veteran, and a recognized thought leader in Digital, Data, and Artificial Intelligence, driving industrial transformation to create sustainable business value. Known for being “patiently impatient” in leading change, he has been at the forefront of leveraging technology to transform businesses and operations.Prior to joining Tata Steel as Chief Information Officer over a decade ago, Jayanta was a Business Leader at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), where he headed the Life Sciences and Energy & Resources verticals.With over 33 years of experience within the Tata Group, he has led businesses globally across strategy, sales, delivery, operations, and digital transformation.A widely travelled industry speaker and technology evangelist, Jayanta has championed several pioneering initiatives in Industry 4.0, Industry 5.0, AI, and digital transformation. He serves on the boards of Tata Steel Global Capability Centre Limited and Mjunction Services Limited and actively contributes to leading industry forums and institutions globally.Jayanta is a member of the Advisory Board of the World Economic Forum’s Global Lighthouse Network and actively collaborates with global leaders on the future of advanced manufacturing, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence. He also serves as Chair of the IFQM Digital Chapter and participates in the MIT Generative AI Consortium.He is an alumnus of CEDEP (France), AIMA–Berkeley, and the Ross School of Business (Tata Management Training Centre).Beyond his professional commitments, Jayanta is passionate about fitness, wellness, and mentoring aspiring leaders, helping shape the next generation of technology and business professionals.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Founded by Jamsetji Tata in 1868, the Tata group is a global enterprise headquartered in India. past.employer_linkedin_description: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is the technology partner of choice for industry-leading organizations worldwide. Since its inception in 1968, TCS has upheld the highest standards of innovation, engineering excellence, and customer service.It has set an aspiration to become the world's largest AI-led technology services company and is enabling its clients to transform themselves across the full AI stack, from infrastructure to intelligence.Rooted in the heritage of the Tata Group, TCS is focused on creating long term value for its clients, its investors, its employees, and the community at large. With a highly skilled workforce spread across 56 countries and 194 service delivery centers across the world, the company has been recognized as a top employer in six continents. With the ability to rapidly apply and scale new technologies, the company has built long-term partnerships with its clients. Many of these relationships have endured into decades and navigated every technology cycle, from mainframes in the 1970s to artificial intelligence today.TCS sponsors 14 of the world’s most prestigious marathons and endurance events, including the TCS New York City Marathon, TCS London Marathon, Tata Mumbai Marathon, and TCS Sydney Marathon with a focus on promoting health, sustainability, and community empowerment.Caution against fraudulent job offers: TCS doesn’t charge any fee throughout the recruitment process. basic_profile.name: Dinesh Kumar Shrimali
basic_profile.headline: Chief Information Security Officer and Data Protection Officer
basic_profile.current_title: Chief Information Security Officer and Data Protection Officer
basic_profile.summary:
I have a distinguished career in the field of Information Technology and am an accomplished professional. With more than two decades of experience, I have amassed a wealth of knowledge in advancing strategic security initiatives and mitigating complex cyber risks. A track record of successfully aligning cybersecurity strategies with business objectives, allowing organizations to confidently navigate an ever-changing threat landscape. I have witnessed the evolution of my profession, most notably the rapid rise of digitization and the central role that cybersecurity plays in shaping the future of economies across the globe. I contribute a strategic perspective and the ability to generate results through effective planning and execution.

Throughout my tenure, I have led the design and implementation of enterprise-wide security programmes while holding key positions. My experience includes information security, risk management, compliance, and data privacy, among others. The best method, in my opinion, to assist individuals and businesses in enhancing their security posture is to provide them with the knowledge and tools necessary to make informed decisions and implement effective solutions.

I look forward to the expanding cybersecurity market and my continued dedication to ensuring everyone and every organization has a safe and secure online future.

basic_profile.name: Sanjeev Bhatia, PCC
basic_profile.headline: ICF-PCC Coach | Leadership, Culture & Transformation
basic_profile.summary:
Sanjeev Bhatia is the CEO of Knowbility Ventures Pvt. Ltd., a Consulting and Coaching firm specializing in leadership and change for purpose-driven organizations that seek to have an impact beyond the bottom line. He also works extensively as an Executive Coach in supporting leaders to find their unique calling in life, and to speak their truth from a place of purpose and power. He focuses on enabling them to discover and live their purpose, so they can lead a more fulfilled and meaningful life. 
He makes himself available and coaches the HR leaders who are in transition from a local to a global role. He also loves to devote his time to helping visionary leaders discover their ‘LIVING MESSAGE’, so they can give their greatest gifts to society and build a successful practice to solve big, important problems that help change the world. So,  
•	Where do you want to make a difference in your company and in your life? 
•	What do you value most? Are you living those values?  
•	How do you deal with disappointment or failure? 
•	What motivates you? 
•	What is your true purpose? 
Sanjeev can help you explore a compelling vision that can take any goal, action, or outcome with new power and energy within you.

basic_profile.name: Kritika Singh
basic_profile.headline: HR Manager at Tata Steel with expertise in HR strategy and stakeholder engagement.
basic_profile.summary:
As an experienced Human Resources Business Partner with a passion for people, culture, and performance, I bring nearly a decade of expertise in driving strategic HR initiatives across diverse industries. My journey has spanned talent management, employee engagement, industrial relations, and organizational development — helping businesses align people strategy with business goals.

At Tata Steel, I currently lead HR and IR for the Ferro Alloy Plant, partnering with business leaders to enhance employee experience, ensure compliance, and strengthen workforce capability. Previously with YES Bank and Aditya Birla Finance, I spearheaded talent programs, employee engagement surveys, and HR process improvements that drove measurable impact — from reducing onboarding time to improving engagement scores.

I believe HR is not just about managing people but about empowering them to grow, perform, and thrive. My approach blends data-driven decision-making with empathy, creating workplaces that balance efficiency with culture.

Outside work, I’m an avid traveller, scuba diver, and active volunteer with the NGO Being Social, reflecting my belief in continuous learning and giving back to the community.

basic_profile.name: Anubhuti Banerjee
basic_profile.headline: Sr. Area Manager(EA to CIO) at Tata Steel and Freelance Screenwriter
basic_profile.current_title: Founder & Lead - LGBTQ Employee Resource Group
basic_profile.summary:
Anubhuti is a Senior Area Manager functioning as the Executive Assistant to CIO (Chief Information Officer, part of the AI/Digital Leadership team at Tata Steel, with over 13 years experience in Digital and AI Strategy and Analytics.

At Tata Steel she founded and leads an industry pioneering Employee Resource Group at Tata Steel called “Wings”, one of the first in the country, especially in the Manufacturing sector. It was a pivotal first step of LGBTQ Inclusion on Tata Steel’s journey towards becoming a World Economic Forum (WEF), Global DEI Lighthouse, one of the only 8 in the world, and the only one in India. She has also been part of the movement for LGBTQ+ Inclusion on India Inc. as a whole.

Anubhuti is also an US State Dept’s IVLP Fellow in Screenwriting, a DAAD (German Academic Exchange) Research Fellow, a Mingle Young LGBT+ leader reflecting the diversity in her areas of interests and proficiency. She also regularly shares her experience – her Anubhuti – of what it is like being a self-made woman of steel in Corporate India.

current.employee_description:
Anubhuti Banerjee is a freelance screenwriter who begin her storytelling journey with a series produced for Amazon Prime Video (Release awaited). Also working as a senior manager and executive assistant to the CIO at Tata Steel in Mumbai, Anubhuti leads efforts for inclusion of underrepresented groups at her workplace, an effort which won recognition by the World Economic Forum's Global Parity Alliance. She has taken part in various workshops, trainings, and filmmaking labs, and her screenwriting mixes fantasy, myth, horror and humor. 

Her Hindi feature film script T102 Yari Road was selected by the Writer’s INK Feature Film Writing Lab (India’s top screenwriting lab) to be made into a film.

She hopes to continue advocating for inclusive practices in India's entertainment industry.
